messages:
ajay: Quick sync — NimbusHealth SI handoff scheduled Mon 3/30. They need: 1) arch review, 2) terraform provider for our private image + marketplace metadata, 3) DB proxy enablement, 4) KMS key access pattern. Who's on this?
sara: I can cover arch review Tue. Need the customer's network diagram + expected qps.
mike_sre: DB proxy note: SI will need outbound to our egress IPs on 5432. Also require MTLS for the proxy. We'll need cert provisioning flow.
ajay: Thanks. @elaine can you confirm SI's terraform experience? we have a sample provider module: 
```hcl
module "redwood_private_image" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/inference/terraform//modules/private_image"
  image_tag = "nimbus-v1.2.0"
  kms_key = "projects/..."
}
```
sara: Looks good. Recommend pinning provider to 0.3.x for compatibility with our private deploy infra.
elaine: Tom from SI said they prefer CloudFormation but will take terraform. I'll push the provider sample to their repo and do a walkthrough Wed.
tom_ops: Confirming — will need a signed image and attestations. Do you have automated image signing steps?
ajay: Yes — we'll share marketplace image sig script and the upload endpoint. Also note: private deploy uses cert-based auth; add the service account name to the allowlist.
mike_sre: I'll open the network rule ticket and PR for the cert flows.
oncall-bot: incident-12345 created: 'SI NimbusHealth egress IP allowlist' assigned to eng-sre
elaine: Can we sync on rollback strategy? If SI deployment fails can we fallback to hosted model? customer requires failover plan.
sara: Yes — suggest feature flag + A/B fallback to hosted. I'll draft runbook and test checklist.
tom_ops: Timeline from SI: walkthru Wed, infra changes Thu, test Fri, go-live Mon. Any blockers?
ajay: Blocker: need signed attestations from our image sig pipeline; @mike_sre can you confirm artifact signing will be ready by Thu?
mike_sre: I can expedite. Will update incident-12345 with CI job id + expected completion time by EOD.
sara: :thumbsup: I'll prepare arch slides & a concise port list. @elaine can you send SI contact list and repo access?
elaine: Sent invites and repo access to dmitri and lisa. Scheduling the 30m walkthrough for Wed 10am PT, calendar invites sent.
tom_ops: Added to our calendar. Quick Q: any firewall openings needed for marketplace services?
ajay: No marketplace IPs for private deploy — only our egress IPs and the KMS endpoints. I'll DM the exact IP list and KMS fqdn.
dmitri: Thanks team — terraform crew ready. We'll review the module and flag any changes before Wed.
ajay: Great — will post links to the repo, runbook, and the signed image manifest in this thread by EOD.
